words.sense: sugary, insincere flattery and slick manner
misconceptions: Flattering someone smoothly need not mean obeying their every command.

words.sense: exaggerated submission and eagerness to obey
misconceptions: Constantly obeying someone need not involve sugary compliments.

semantic_axes.description: Unctuous behavior is slick, insincere flattery; obsequious behavior is excessive deference and willingness to obey.

edges.boundary_rule: Unctuous behavior is slick, insincere flattery; obsequious behavior is excessive deference and willingness to obey.

misconceptions.M1: Flattering someone smoothly need not mean obeying their every command.
misconceptions.M2: Constantly obeying someone need not involve sugary compliments.
misconceptions.M3: Do not stick with an old answer after decisive evidence changes, or let surface distractions override the boundary.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Mariam’s behavior?

beats.text: Mariam greeted each visitor with an elaborate speech about their exceptional taste, even before learning what they wanted.
beats.decisive_clue: lavish praise offered before knowing anything about a person
beats.reason: The rehearsed, excessive compliments sound insincere.

beats.text: Her voice remained soft while she delivered the same speech again.
beats.decisive_clue: lavish praise offered before knowing anything about a person
beats.reason: A gentle voice does not change the artificial flattery.

chains.feedback_short: The key is lavish praise offered before knowing anything about a person; a gentle voice does not change the artificial flattery.
chains.feedback_deep: Unctuous concerns sugary, insincere flattery and slick manner; obsequious concerns exaggerated submission and eagerness to obey. A gentle voice does not change the artificial flattery.
chains.contrast_rule: Unctuous: lavish artificial praise; obsequious: obeying every whim.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Jun’s behavior?

beats.text: Jun agreed to every instruction his manager gave, even when it contradicted yesterday’s orders.
beats.reason: He submits regardless of the instructions’ merits.

beats.text: He immediately erased his own careful proposal whenever the manager frowned.
beats.decisive_clue: unquestioning obedience at the expense of his own judgment
beats.reason: Discarding his work reinforces how completely he defers to authority.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Isabel’s behavior?

beats.text: Isabel whispered that each donor had uniquely brilliant judgment, then immediately asked them to double their gift.
beats.decisive_clue: calculated, overdone compliments designed to win bigger donations
beats.reason: The praise is polished and clearly serves her request for more money.

beats.text: She delivered each plea while wearing a plain blue jacket.
beats.decisive_clue: calculated, overdone compliments designed to win bigger donations
beats.reason: Clothing has no bearing on the flattering words used to solicit more money.

chains.feedback_short: Calculated, overdone compliments designed to win bigger donations; the later detail does not change the boundary.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Bashir’s behavior?

beats.text: Bashir dropped his own schedule whenever the supervisor asked, even volunteering to complete the supervisor’s personal errands.
beats.decisive_clue: excessive willingness to comply with a superior’s wishes
beats.reason: He goes beyond reasonable workplace cooperation.

beats.text: He still spoke in a perfectly ordinary tone.
beats.decisive_clue: excessive willingness to comply with a superior’s wishes
beats.reason: The lack of sugary speech does not erase his submission.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Mateo’s behavior?

beats.text: Mateo praised his aunt’s plain rice as the finest meal ever cooked, repeating glowing compliments between every bite.
beats.decisive_clue: overblown compliments unrelated to the ordinary meal
beats.reason: The performance of praise is implausibly extravagant.

beats.text: He quietly asked for a second helping.
beats.decisive_clue: overblown compliments unrelated to the ordinary meal
beats.reason: Eating more does not make his wildly exaggerated praise sincere.
